executionPlan: Checked design.md section 9 (app/layout.tsx and ASSETS.md not on the do-not-touch list). Fetched @fontsource/jetbrains-mono 5.3.0 via npm pack into scratch, copied latin 400 and 700 woff2 plus OFL license into app/fonts/jetbrains-mono, switched layout.tsx to next/font/local, documented in ASSETS.md. Measured before and after from clean git-archive copies of HEAD (because game-dev's in-progress edits currently break type-checking in the worktree), offline build under sandbox-exec deny network, CDP screenshots from production servers with canvas hidden and animations frozen.
summary: JetBrains Mono is now self-hosted (woff2 latin 400 and 700 from @fontsource/jetbrains-mono 5.3.0) via next/font/local with the same --font-mono variable, so npm run build passes with network blocked (the same build of the old code fails with ENOTFOUND fonts.googleapis.com under the same sandbox). / First Load JS is unchanged at 125 kB; font bytes for / rose from 41,637 to 45,390 bytes (two static files replace one variable file). Screenshots differ only by antialiasing noise (max channel delta 26 of 255, zero pixels above 32).

testsRun.evidence: ┌ ○ /   40.8 kB   125 kB (no ENOTFOUND in log); control: same sandbox on unmodified HEAD copy exit 1, 'request to https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@100..800&display=swap failed, reason: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND fonts.googleapis.com'

criteria.criterion: app/layout.tsx uses next/font/local with JetBrains Mono font files committed under the app (only the weights and styles the site actually uses, woff2, latin subset where available), exposing the same --font-mono CSS variable and font-mono class so no other file needs to change.
criteria.evidence: layout.tsx uses localFont with variable --font-mono and two woff2 files (latin 400 normal, 700 normal). Grep shows the site only uses default weight and font-bold, no italic. Browser check: body class __variable_* font-mono, computed font-family starts with the local mono family; tailwind.config.ts and globals.css untouched.

criteria.criterion: The font files' source, version, OFL license and the exact weights shipped are recorded in ASSETS.md, with the license file included next to the fonts.
criteria.evidence: ASSETS.md new Fonts section: @fontsource/jetbrains-mono exactly 5.3.0 (npm pack, not a repo dependency), OFL-1.1, weights 400 and 700 latin woff2, sizes and sha256 per file; OFL.txt sits in app/fonts/jetbrains-mono next to the fonts.

criteria.criterion: npm run build exits 0 with network access disabled (prove it by running the build in a copy of the tree with outbound network blocked, for example a sandbox or an unresolvable proxy, and record the exit code); the / route First Load JS and the total font bytes transferred for / are recorded before and after.
criteria.evidence: Offline build exit 0 under sandbox-exec deny network (curl to fonts.googleapis.com failed to resolve inside it; old code failed in the same sandbox with exit 1). Before: / 40.8 kB, First Load JS 125 kB, font bytes 41,637 (1 variable woff2, encoded). After: / 40.8 kB, First Load JS 125 kB, font bytes 45,390 (22,325 + 23,065). Font bytes are about 3.7 KB higher, a trade for shipping only 400 and 700 as static files.

criteria.criterion: Rendered text is visually identical: screenshots of the hero and one content section before and after, at the same viewport, compared with a pixel diff that shows no change in glyph shapes (antialiasing noise only), and no flash of unstyled text on load.
criteria.evidence: 1280x800 screenshots before-hero.png, after-hero.png, before-about.png, after-about.png, diffs diff-hero.png, diff-about.png (canvas hidden, CSS animations frozen so the typewriter and glow are deterministic; an earlier unfrozen run differed only on the typing animation and glow). Hero: 1,222 differing px, max channel delta 26, 0 px above 32; about section: 1,063 px, max 16, 0 px above 32. FOUT: both font files are emitted as link rel=preload as=font, and document.fonts reports both faces loaded at first measurement with display swap, same behaviour as before (before: 1 preload).

criteria.criterion: npm run lint, npm test and npm run build (online) exit 0 with exit codes captured; only app/layout.tsx, the font files and license, and ASSETS.md change; new content has no em dash or machine-local path; no commit is made.
criteria.evidence: lint 0, test 0 (145 passed), online build 0 (run in a clean copy of HEAD plus my files; a build in the live worktree currently fails in components/game/GameScene.tsx:168 WorldView missing props active and handleRef, which is game-dev's in-progress work, not this change). git status for my scope shows only ASSETS.md, app/layout.tsx, app/fonts/. No em dash or local path added (the 4 em dashes in layout.tsx are pre-existing title strings). No commit made.

assumptions: Used production servers on separate ports for before and after screenshots instead of the dev server on 3100 for determinism; the dev server was not touched.
Static 400 and 700 files from @fontsource are used instead of the variable file; weight 400 and 700 glyph outlines render within antialiasing tolerance of the old variable instance.
decisionsProposed: Self-host fonts with next/font/local from a pinned @fontsource package copy so builds stay hermetic.
lessonsProposed: Run offline-build proofs under sandbox-exec '(deny network*)' with a negative control on the old code; measure before/after from git archive HEAD copies when a parallel stage leaves the worktree not type-clean.
